standard_prerequisites.name: Right exactness of tensoring with Z/ell^m and the surjectivity of the induced map on completions
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at lines 1093-1102
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces exactness of A/ell^m -> B/ell^m -> E/ell^m -> 0 and the Mittag-Leffler style surjectivity of the transition maps.

standard_prerequisites.name: Snake lemma and induction on m for the finiteness of the ell-power torsion
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that _{ell^m}E is finite for all m and produces the exact sequence whose projective limit is the desired one.

core_obligations: Part 1: from right exactness of tensoring with Z/ell^m obtain the exact sequence A/ell^m -> B/ell^m -> E/ell^m -> 0, note that the kernels have surjective transition maps, and conclude that the map of ell-adic completions B^(ell) -> E^(ell) stays surjective (proof lines 1093-1102).

Part 2: under the hypothesis that the ell-torsion of E is finite, prove by induction that _{ell^m}E is finite for every m using the exact sequence _{ell}E -> _{ell^{m+1}}E -> _{ell^m}E (proof lines 1104-1110).

Part 2, conclusion: let I be the image of A -> B; by part 1 the map A^(ell) -> I^(ell) is surjective, so it suffices to prove exactness of I^(ell) -> B^(ell) -> E^(ell), which follows by taking the projective limit of the snake-lemma sequence _{ell^m}E -> I/ell^m -> B/ell^m -> E/ell^m because the kernel of I/ell^m -> B/ell^m is a quotient of the finite group _{ell^m}E; the same argument works when A/ell is finite (proof lines 1111-1125).
proof_roadmap: Reduce the surjectivity on completions to surjectivity of the transition maps on the kernels, which right exactness gives (proof lines 1093-1102).
Replace A by the image I of A -> B and take projective limits of the snake-lemma sequences, using the finiteness of _{ell^m}E for all m (proof lines 1104-1125).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes an exact sequence of abelian groups A -> B -> E -> 0 and states that the induced map B^(ell) -> E^(ell) on ell-adic completions is surjective, and that if the ell-torsion of E (or the quotient A/ell) is finite then A^(ell) -> B^(ell) -> E^(ell) -> 0 is again exact (statement lines 1074-1087). The proof first exploits right exactness of tensoring with Z/ell^m to get surjectivity of the maps on the kernels of the completed sequence, and then replaces A by the image I of A -> B so that the snake lemma can be applied and projective limits taken along the finite quotients _{ell^m}E (proof lines 1093-1125). The step that cannot be done by a single cited theorem is the middle one: passing to the projective limit requires the finiteness of the ell-power torsion for every m, which the author proves by an explicit induction using the short exact sequences _{ell}E -> _{ell^{m+1}}E -> _{ell^m}E. Both hypotheses of the second part are used in the proof, and the two cases are handled separately. H2.
